definitions.explanation: A magazine or periodical that is published once a month.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{月刊誌|げっかんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read this monthly magazine every month.

examples.japanese: {月刊誌|げっかんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最新号|さいしんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The latest issue of the monthly magazine arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{月刊誌|げっかんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定期購読|ていきこうどく}→定期購読：16116_teikikoudoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have a subscription to a hobby monthly magazine.

notes:
{月刊誌|げっかんし} refers to a magazine published once a month. The word combines ⟦{月刊|げっかん}→月刊：16257_gekkan⟧ (monthly publication) with {誌|し} (magazine).

FORMS:
{月|げつ} (month) + {刊|かん} (publication) + {誌|し} (magazine)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read a monthly magazine
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定期購読|ていきこうどく}→定期購読：16116_teikikoudoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to subscribe to a monthly magazine
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最新号|さいしんごう}: the latest issue of a monthly magazine

PUBLICATION FREQUENCY TERMS:
- ⟦{週刊誌|しゅうかんし}→週刊誌：11179_shuukanshi⟧: weekly magazine
- ⟦{隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}→隔週刊：26653_kakushuukan⟧: biweekly
- {月刊誌|げっかんし}: monthly magazine
- ⟦{季刊誌|きかんし}→季刊誌：11514_kikanshi⟧: quarterly magazine
- {年刊|ねんかん}: annual publication
